MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the Current Market Regime?
NEUTRAL per the supplied regime: volatility is normal at 28.1%, but breadth is weak at 1/8 sectors positive. Participation is narrow, with only Technology & Telecom advancing over the week.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Technology & Telecom leads in RECOVERY (1W: +8.87% | 1M: -8.40%); KONTR (1W: +32.61% | 1M: -8.50%) is its standout. Construction & REIT is the least weak, but remains BELOW TREND (1W: -0.70% | 1M: -10.86%).

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Energy & Chemicals is the weakest sector, BELOW TREND (1W: -10.61% | 1M: -20.34%), followed by Heavy Industry (1W: -8.05% | 1M: -16.55%). Selling pressure is broad, with seven of eight sectors negative over the week.

STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
KONTR (1W: +32.61% | 1M: -8.50%) is RECOVERY; TKFEN (1W: +12.39% | 1M: -17.29%) is RECOVERY; ENKAI (1W: +4.29% | 1M: -7.03%) is RECOVERY. ASELS (1W: +2.59% | 1M: +3.12%) is ABOVE TREND; TSKB (1W: +0.79% | 1M: -7.26%) is RECOVERY.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
GUBRF (1W: -24.51% | 1M: -38.47%), VESTL (1W: -22.01% | 1M: -37.53%), EREGL (1W: -15.50% | 1M: -17.47%), HEKTS (1W: -12.57% | 1M: -21.57%) and SASA (1W: -11.59% | 1M: -19.44%) are all BELOW TREND.

6. Momentum Stocks?
The strongest weekly moves are KONTR (1W: +32.61% | 1M: -8.50%), TKFEN (1W: +12.39% | 1M: -17.29%) and ENKAI (1W: +4.29% | 1M: -7.03%), all RECOVERY. ASELS (1W: +2.59% | 1M: +3.12%) is ABOVE TREND; watch whether these gains broaden beyond a handful of names.

SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Banking Sector Outlook?
Banking is BELOW TREND overall (1W: -4.25% | 1M: -5.70%). AKBNK (1W: -5.73% | 1M: -9.10%) and ISCTR (1W: -6.20% | 1M: -4.51%) are BELOW TREND; GARAN (1W: -2.57% | 1M: +1.87%) is in CORRECTION.

8. Industrial Sector Outlook?
Heavy Industry remains weak, BELOW TREND (1W: -8.05% | 1M: -16.55%). ASELS (1W: +2.59% | 1M: +3.12%) is ABOVE TREND, contrasting with FROTO (1W: -1.65% | 1M: -11.01%) and EREGL (1W: -15.50% | 1M: -17.47%), both BELOW TREND.

9. Energy & Chemicals Outlook?
Energy & Chemicals is the weakest sector, BELOW TREND (1W: -10.61% | 1M: -20.34%). TUPRS (1W: -2.48% | 1M: -8.70%), PETKM (1W: -11.26% | 1M: -14.12%) and GUBRF (1W: -24.51% | 1M: -38.47%) are all BELOW TREND.

PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor a defensive, selective stance and keep risk controlled: normal volatility does not offset extremely narrow breadth. Avoid broad cyclical exposure until participation improves; treat sharp RECOVERY moves as unconfirmed without sustained follow-through.

NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
Track KONTR (1W: +32.61% | 1M: -8.50%) and TKFEN (1W: +12.39% | 1M: -17.29%) for recovery follow-through, alongside ASELS (1W: +2.59% | 1M: +3.12%) for trend confirmation. ENKAI (1W: +4.29% | 1M: -7.03%) and TSKB (1W: +0.79% | 1M: -7.26%) are also potential breadth tests; both remain RECOVERY.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
Monitor Technology & Telecom for whether its weekly strength persists despite a negative month (1W: +8.87% | 1M: -8.40%). Watch Construction & REIT for stabilization (1W: -0.70% | 1M: -10.86%) and Energy & Chemicals for any easing in the sell-off (1W: -10.61% | 1M: -20.34%).

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
No XU100 price levels are provided, so specific support and resistance levels cannot be assessed from this data. Key triggers are a pickup in sector breadth, stabilization in energy and industrial shares, and follow-through in recent weekly leaders.

EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

The supplied regime is NEUTRAL, with normal volatility but only 1/8 sectors positive, leaving the market vulnerable to continued narrow participation. Technology-led rebounds offer selective opportunities, but widespread BELOW TREND conditions—especially in Energy & Chemicals and Heavy Industry—argue for a cautious stance until breadth improves.
